title: Chris Camillo / Dumb Money documented calls
policy: 43 research records, not 43 verified trades. The set includes excluded attributions, themes, misses, third-party mentions, and repeats. Do not compute a win rate, expected return, or strategy efficacy. Incomplete history cannot support those estimates. Personal P&L is self-reported unless a journalist viewed statements or screenshots, and a purchase screenshot is not exit proceeds. Schwager's review of monthly statements, as reported by Business Insider, is not a published audit of every trade or of later headline totals. This project did not audit the account.

verification_levels.independently_reviewed: Schwager statement audit and/or Business Insider review of tax forms or statements — used for career totals, not usually for a single trade's P&L.
verification_levels.screenshots_viewed_by_journalist: A journalist reported viewing purchase or position screenshots. Still not an audited closed P&L unless stated.
verification_levels.self_reported: Camillo or a close collaborator said it, in a named interview or book, without a third-party close-out.
verification_levels.self_reported_and_market_fact: The thesis and timing are self-reported; a contemporaneous market move is independently observable.
verification_levels.third_party_mention: Named by a commentator (e.g. Chart Academy, Matt Ober) without a primary Camillo P&L.
verification_levels.missed_opportunity: Camillo said he missed it, or a marketing figure is not his trade.
verification_levels.unconfirmed_ticker: A story exists; the listed vehicle is not securely identified.
verification_levels.rejected_no_source: Popular attribution with no source — not a trade in this database.

trades.name: Snapple puts
trades.thesis: He noticed Snapple losing shelf space at a 7-Eleven (a favorite flavor gone; doors cut back) and, through his brother, bought puts on Snapple. Not a story of Snapple winning while he shorted a competitor.
trades.outcome: Personal recollection of about a 3x. The listed vehicle, the year, and the execution are unresolved. Not a verified trade.
trades.source: Tearsheet / Tradestreaming, Zack Miller, 12 Dec 2011; same direction in Business Insider, 7 Dec 2020.
trades.notes: Date often given as late 1980s. Exact counterparty ticker is not independently confirmed.
trades.thesis_zh: 他注意到 7-Eleven 里 Snapple 货架在缩小（常喝的口味没有了，冰箱门被砍掉），并通过哥哥买入 Snapple 的看跌期权。不是「Snapple 在赢、他做空竞争对手」。
trades.outcome_zh: 个人回忆大约 3 倍。上市工具、年份和成交都未解决。不是已核实交易。

trades.name: UGGs / Deckers
trades.thesis: Cultural adoption of UGG boots ahead of Street recognition.
trades.signal: Street-level and cultural observation; discussed in Laughing at Wall Street.
trades.outcome: Self-reported winning example. No audited P&L.
trades.source: Laughing at Wall Street (2011); later interviews.
trades.thesis_zh: UGG 靴子的文化采用早于卖方认识。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述的盈利例子。没有已审计盈亏。
trades.instrument_zh: 未说明（书中时代的股票或期权）

trades.name: True Religion jeans
trades.thesis: Premium denim cultural wave.
trades.outcome: Self-reported winning example. No audited P&L. Marketing illustrations in the book (e.g. $1k to $750k) are unaudited.
trades.thesis_zh: 高端牛仔的文化浪潮。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述的盈利例子。没有已审计盈亏。书中的营销数字（例如 1000 美元到 75 万美元）未经审计。

trades.name: Nintendo Wii vs PS3/Xbox
trades.thesis: Wii's casual-gamer adoption was being underestimated versus Sony/Microsoft.
trades.signal: In-store and cultural observation. Tearsheet: a 'huge play.'
trades.outcome: Described as a large winning play. No P&L figure in the primary source we retrieved.
trades.thesis_zh: Wii 的休闲玩家采用被相对索尼和微软低估。
trades.outcome_zh: 被描述为一笔大的盈利。我们取得的一手来源里没有盈亏数字。

trades.name: Cerner electronic medical records
trades.thesis: EMR adoption wave.
trades.outcome: Self-reported 'I believe 700%' over about two years. Unaudited; wording is hedged.
trades.thesis_zh: 电子病历采用浪潮。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述「我相信约 700%」，大约两年。未经审计，措辞有保留。

trades.name: Chuggington / Facebook buzz
trades.thesis: Children's show gaining unexpected Facebook traction.
trades.outcome: Self-reported about 50% in months. Listed vehicle not securely identified.
trades.thesis_zh: 儿童节目在 Facebook 上出现意外热度。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述数月内约 50%。上市工具没有可靠识别。

trades.name: “Delcasse” medical-study story
trades.thesis: A medical-study related idea (some readers have guessed Dendreon; we do not).
trades.outcome: Ticker unconfirmed. Do not treat as a verified Camillo trade.
trades.thesis_zh: 与一项医学研究有关的想法（有读者猜是 Dendreon；我们不这么定）。
trades.outcome_zh: 代码未证实。不要当成已核实的 Camillo 交易。

trades.name: Silicon Image HDMI — method failure
trades.thesis: HDMI adoption. Camillo later cited this as a case where personal bias overrode the method.
trades.outcome: Described as a loss and a process failure, not a model failure of the information itself.
trades.thesis_zh: HDMI 采用。他后来把这笔当作个人偏见压过方法的例子。
trades.outcome_zh: 被描述为亏损和流程失败，不是信息本身的模型失败。

trades.name: Target × Missoni
trades.thesis: He recalled waiting in line, seeing a Missoni for Target sellout, and buying leveraged options that day, out the next morning. Target’s 16 Sep 2011 statement says the nationwide launch was 13 Sep 2011. The 7 Sep 2011 anchor is withdrawn. Executions and the option return are unverified.
trades.signal: Pre-event consumer chatter and collab marketing. The sell-out is a documented retail event (September 2011).
trades.outcome: Self-reported overnight double on options. Not verified. Any price path from 13 Sep is the equity path from the retail launch, not his option return.
trades.source: Tearsheet 2011; contemporaneous retail coverage of the Missoni sell-out.
trades.thesis_zh: 他回忆当天排队、看见 Missoni for Target 售罄，并买入杠杆期权，次日早上退出。Target 2011 年 9 月 16 日的声明称全国上市是 9 月 13 日。2011 年 9 月 7 日的锚点已撤回。成交和期权收益未核实。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述期权隔夜翻倍。未核实。从 9 月 13 日起的价格路径是零售上市日的股票路径，不是他的期权收益。

trades.name: Michelle Obama J.Crew — missed
trades.thesis: A widely cited marketing story (sometimes '186%') is not a Camillo win. Tearsheet: he missed it.
trades.outcome: Logged as a missed opportunity, not a winning trade. Do not repeat the 186% figure as his return.
trades.source: Tearsheet 2011 (he missed it); later marketing copy that misattributes the figure.
trades.thesis_zh: 广为引用的营销故事（有时写成 186%）不是他的盈利。Tearsheet：他错过了。
trades.outcome_zh: 记为错过的机会，不是盈利交易。不要把 186% 写成他的收益。

trades.name: e.l.f. Beauty / Jeffree Star
trades.thesis: In the 7 Dec 2020 interview he recalled a March 2019 Jeffree Star video and pharmacy sellouts, then a purchase. The purchase day is not in the interview. The video upload day is not independently dated.
trades.signal: Influencer / YouTube beauty culture plus channel checks.
trades.outcome: He said the stock rose more than 50% in the six weeks after his initial purchase. Self-reported market path, not audited P&L. No single-number lead is published.
trades.thesis_zh: 2020 年 12 月 7 日的访谈里，他回忆 2019 年 3 月的 Jeffree Star 视频和药店售罄，然后买入。访谈没有买入日。视频上传日没有独立日期。
trades.outcome_zh: 他说首次买入后六周股价涨超 50%。这是自述的价格路径，不是已审计盈亏。不发布单一数字的领先时间。

trades.name: Restaurant Brands — April 2019
trades.thesis: Impossible Whopper and Popeyes chicken sandwich, later offset by Tim Hortons weakness. Not a Tim Hortons turnaround bet. April 2019 purchase; day not published. Screenshots viewed by BI.
trades.outcome: Part of a self-reported loss of about $750,000. Purchase screenshot is not exit proceeds.
trades.thesis_zh: Impossible Whopper 与 Popeyes 鸡肉三明治，后来被 Tim Hortons 的疲弱抵消。不是 Tim Hortons 翻盘赌注。2019 年 4 月买入；日未公布。BI 看过截图。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述约 75 万美元亏损的一部分。买入截图不是退出所得。

trades.name: Restaurant Brands — August 2019
trades.thesis: Second 2019 purchase, same Whopper / Popeyes thesis. August is the month BI reported; the day was not published.
trades.outcome: Folded into the same self-reported loss of about $750,000.
trades.thesis_zh: 2019 年第二次买入，仍是 Whopper / Popeyes 论点。BI 报道的是 8 月；日未公布。
trades.outcome_zh: 并入同一笔自述的约 75 万美元亏损。

trades.name: COVID shorts (SPY / Wynn puts)
trades.thesis: He described translating Chinese newspapers and blogs in February 2020, not academic papers, then buying puts and shorting SPY outright, plus Wynn puts.
trades.signal: Primary foreign-language research, not a social-app meme.
trades.instrument: puts on SPY and Wynn; 25–30% of savings, self-reported
trades.outcome: Self-reported: losing at first, then seven figures in a week around early March. Not verified as a complete exit. Not put or short P&L on the equity path.
trades.source: Stansberry Investor Hour episode 192 transcript page.
trades.notes: Exact put strikes and premiums were not published. Do not invent them.
trades.thesis_zh: 他描述 2020 年 2 月翻译中文报纸和博客，不是学术论文，然后买入看跌期权并直接做空 SPY，外加 Wynn 的看跌期权。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述：起初亏损，然后在三月初的一周赚到七位数。没有核实为完整平仓。股价路径不是期权或做空损益。
trades.instrument_zh: 看跌期权，以及直接做空 SPY（自述）

trades.name: Dorel Industries (home / bikes, COVID)
trades.thesis: Stay-at-home demand for Dorel's bike and home lines, as told to Business Insider.
trades.signal: COVID consumption shift; purchase screenshots dated 24 April 2020 at $1.56, viewed by BI. Gradual selling around June near $4.46; full exit November, when the stock was $11.38.
trades.exit: gradual June ~$4.46; full exit November 2020, stock $11.38 that day (BI)
trades.outcome: BI: screenshots of a 24 Apr 2020 purchase at $1.56, gradual selling near $4.46 in June, and a November exit with the stock at $11.38, which the article calls a 629% rise. That is a described price path, not verified personal return and not the EPS figure. The stored adjusted close that day (~$0.69) is not directly comparable.
trades.source: Business Insider, Laila Maidan, 18 Aug 2021. Issuer release 10 Aug 2020.
trades.thesis_zh: 向《商业内幕》讲述的、居家带来的 Dorel 自行车和家居需求。
trades.outcome_zh: BI：2020 年 4 月 24 日以 1.56 美元买入的截图，6 月在约 4.46 美元附近分批卖出，11 月退出时股价 11.38 美元，文章称之为上涨 629%。这是被描述的价格路径，不是已核实的个人收益率，也不是每股收益。当日库存复权收盘（约 0.69 美元）不能直接比较。

trades.name: Peloton 2020
trades.thesis: Stay-at-home fitness hardware/software wave.
trades.outcome: Self-reported to Stansberry as maybe the biggest of his life: '$4 million… relatively small investment.' Unaudited. Entry date not precise enough for a tight event study.
trades.thesis_zh: 居家健身硬件和软件。
trades.outcome_zh: 向 Stansberry 自述也许是一生最大的一笔：「400 万美元……相对小的投资。」未经审计。进场日不够精确。

trades.name: Amazon stay-at-home / later earnings options
trades.thesis: E-commerce acceleration. A later comment describes a large Amazon options position into earnings.
trades.signal: Consumption shift; later a catalyst-timed options structure.
trades.instrument: equity and, later, options (self-reported $10M options — treat as a separate, less-dated claim)
trades.outcome: Named in 2020-era interviews. The $10M options figure is self-reported in later podcasts and is not a closed audited P&L.
trades.source: Business Insider 2021; later podcasts including VladTV 2026.
trades.thesis_zh: 电商加速。后来的评论描述一笔很大的亚马逊期权、做到财报。
trades.outcome_zh: 2020 年前后的访谈里点过名。1000 万美元期权数字是后来播客里的自述，不是已审计的平仓盈亏。
trades.instrument_zh: 股票，以及后来的期权（自述）

trades.name: Shopify 2020
trades.thesis: DTC / e-commerce infrastructure during lockdowns. BI quotes a view that it should never have gone down.
trades.outcome: Named; no audited personal P&L.
trades.thesis_zh: 封锁期间的 DTC / 电商基础设施。BI 引述一种看法：它本不该下跌。
trades.outcome_zh: 被点名；没有已审计的个人盈亏。

trades.name: Outdoor / recreation 2020 theme
trades.thesis: Outdoor recreation demand during COVID.
trades.outcome: Theme named; individual tickers and P&L not fully specified in the sources we have.
trades.thesis_zh: 新冠期间的户外需求。
trades.outcome_zh: 主题被点名；我们手头的来源没有把每个代码和盈亏写全。

trades.name: HP printers
trades.thesis: Work-from-home printer demand, named on Stansberry.
trades.outcome: Named. No P&L evidence. Not a win.
trades.thesis_zh: 在家办公的打印机需求，Stansberry 上点过名。
trades.outcome_zh: 只是被点名。没有盈亏证据。不是一笔盈利记录。

trades.name: Logitech webcams
trades.thesis: WFH webcam shortage / demand.
trades.outcome: Named on Stansberry. No P&L evidence. Not graded as a win.
trades.outcome_zh: Stansberry 上点过名。没有盈亏证据。不记为盈利。
trades.thesis_zh: 在家办公、网络摄像头短缺或需求。

trades.name: Pet companies — missed
trades.thesis: He said he missed 6–7 pet-related names that later rose 3–6x.
trades.signal: A trend he noticed too late or did not act on.
trades.outcome: Missed opportunity, self-reported. Names not listed.
trades.thesis_zh: 他说自己错过了 6 到 7 个后来涨了 3 到 6 倍的宠物相关名字。
trades.outcome_zh: 错过的机会，自述。名字没有列出。

trades.name: Election / Biden-related stocks
trades.thesis: Policy-and-culture positioning around the 2020 US election.
trades.outcome: Named; no ticker list or P&L in the transcript we have.
trades.thesis_zh: 围绕 2020 年美国大选的政策与文化定位。
trades.outcome_zh: 被点名；我们有的文字稿里没有代码表或盈亏。

trades.name: Newell / Elmer's slime
trades.thesis: Elmer's slime craze: about 50% of a product line's revenue and only 1–2% of the company — a materiality edge-case he still traded with leverage.
trades.outcome: Self-reported 'close to 200%' leveraged. CMC Markets interview, September 2022. Unaudited.
trades.thesis_zh: Elmer's 史莱姆热：一条产品线收入的大约 50%，公司的 1%–2%。这是他自己的物质性边界例子，他仍用杠杆做了。不是本项目的「1%–2% 通常不重要」规则。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述杠杆下「接近 200%」。CMC Markets 访谈，2022 年 9 月。未经审计。

trades.name: Tapestry (Coach) position
trades.thesis: Coach / Tapestry social interest. The 18 Aug 2021 article is when BI reported a $3.1 million position. That date is not a fill. 15 Aug 2021 is the article's Playa year-to-date cutoff.
trades.outcome: Position size viewed by a journalist, not a closed P&L and not exit proceeds.
trades.thesis_zh: Coach / Tapestry 的社交兴趣。2021 年 8 月 18 日的文章报道了 310 万美元持仓。该日不是成交日。2021 年 8 月 15 日是文章里 Playa 的年初至今截止日期。
trades.outcome_zh: 记者看过的持仓规模，不是已平仓盈亏，也不是退出所得。

trades.name: Playa Hotels thesis
trades.thesis: Travel reopening / resort demand.
trades.outcome: Thesis described to BI. The stock was +32% year-to-date through 15 August 2021 — a market fact, not his verified return. Entry date unknown.
trades.thesis_zh: 海滩度假搜索升温后的 Playa 论点。文章给出的「年初至 8 月 15 日约涨 32%」是发表文中的市场截止日期，不是交易日。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述重仓。+32% 是到 2021 年 8 月 15 日的年初至今市场事实，不是他的已核实收益，也不是进场日。

trades.name: Crocs multi-year, incl. HeyDude
trades.thesis: Crocs cultural re-acceleration, then HeyDude as a 'geographical arbitrage' (trend visible in one region before another).
trades.instrument: equity, still adding as of 2021–2022 interviews
trades.exit: still long as of Benzinga 3 August 2022
trades.outcome: In 2021 he said he was still adding after the stock had already tripled (self-reported stance; the triple is a market path). Benzinga 3 Aug 2022: HeyDude geographical arbitrage, still long. No audited closed P&L.
trades.thesis_zh: Crocs 的文化再加速，然后 HeyDude 作为「地理套利」。
trades.outcome_zh: 2021 年他说股票已经翻了三倍仍在加仓（自述立场；三倍是市场路径）。Benzinga 2022 年 8 月 3 日：仍持有。没有已审计的平仓盈亏。

trades.name: GameStop January 2021
trades.thesis: He bought during the squeeze, not as a 'prediction' from YouTube titles. Stansberry: bought around $70, sold a chunk around $300–340.
trades.outcome: Self-reported on Stansberry ep. 192. Marketing that he 'predicted the squeeze' from YouTube titles alone is weaker and is not used here.
trades.thesis_zh: 他是在轧空期间买入，不是从 YouTube 标题「预测」出来的。Stansberry：大约 70 美元买入，一部分在大约 300–340 美元卖出。
trades.outcome_zh: Stansberry 第 192 期自述。仅凭 YouTube 标题说他预测了轧空，证据更弱，这里不用。

trades.name: AMC January 2021
trades.thesis: Related meme-squeeze participation.
trades.outcome: Self-reported about $1.2–1.3 million on about $300k, donated to a pediatric foundation. Unaudited.
trades.thesis_zh: 相关的迷因轧空参与。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述约 30 万美元变成约 120–130 万美元，捐给一家儿科基金会。未经审计。

trades.name: Silver squeeze 2021
trades.thesis: Brief participation in the 2021 silver squeeze.
trades.outcome: Self-reported +$300k then 'a little positive' after giving some back.
trades.thesis_zh: 短暂参与 2021 年白银轧空。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述先赚 30 万美元，吐回一些后「略正」。

trades.name: AWS via Reddit developer forums
trades.thesis: Developer-forum chatter implied AWS demand stronger than consensus.
trades.outcome: Described on VladTV 2026. Dates vague. Unaudited.
trades.thesis_zh: 开发者论坛的讨论意味着 AWS 需求强于共识。
trades.outcome_zh: 2026 年 VladTV 上的描述。日期含糊。未经审计。

trades.name: Salesforce via CRM sales forums
trades.thesis: Sales-forum chatter on deal flow.
trades.outcome: VladTV 2026. Dates vague. Unaudited.
trades.thesis_zh: 销售论坛上的成交讨论。
trades.outcome_zh: 2026 年 VladTV。日期含糊。未经审计。

trades.name: Beacon Roofing / 'roof repair' Trends
trades.thesis: Google Trends for 'roof repair' as a demand proxy.
trades.outcome: Self-reported example. Date and P&L not given in the source we used.
trades.thesis_zh: 用「屋顶维修」的 Google Trends 代理需求。
trades.outcome_zh: 自述例子。所用来源没有日期和盈亏。

trades.name: Lululemon product terms (not a documented exit)
trades.thesis: The thread uses Lululemon product terms as an example of Trends readings that do not match card, web, app, and store signals, and hypothesizes external AI query leakage. It does not say he held or exited Lululemon.
trades.signal: Google Trends — and a meta-signal that the tool itself had broken.
trades.outcome: No Lululemon position or exit is established. The disclosure in the thread is a short in GOOGL. AI contamination remains a hypothesis.
trades.thesis_zh: 该帖把 Lululemon 产品词当作 Trends 与刷卡、网页、应用和到店信号不符的例子，并假设外部人工智能查询漏进 Trends。帖子没有说他持有或退出 Lululemon。
trades.outcome_zh: 没有建立 Lululemon 持仓或退出。帖子里的披露是做空 GOOGL。人工智能污染仍是假设。

trades.name: Short GOOGL disclosed 2025
trades.thesis: The same thread discloses: Short $GOOGL. It does not give size, entry, or exit.
trades.signal: unspecified in the sources we logged
trades.outcome: Disclosed stance only. Not an audited position or P&L.
trades.thesis_zh: 同一帖子披露：做空 GOOGL。没有规模、进场或退出。
trades.outcome_zh: 只是披露的立场。不是已审计的持仓或盈亏。

trades.name: Moissanite microcap 2021
trades.thesis: A tiny moissanite name. He also said 'I don’t ever invest in microcaps' as a general rule — this is the exception that tests it.
trades.outcome: Mentioned on Stansberry. Ticker not named. Size described as tiny.
trades.thesis_zh: 一个很小的莫桑石名字。他同时说过一般不投微型股——这是检验那条规则的例外。
trades.outcome_zh: Stansberry 上提到。代码未点名。规模被说成很小。

trades.name: Most regretful trade (unnamed calls)
trades.thesis: Schwager recounts he liquidated two-thirds of calls at a loss after listening to others; the thesis was later validated.
trades.signal: Original thesis intact; process broken by outside opinions.
trades.exit: two-thirds liquidated at a loss, self-reported via Schwager
trades.outcome: A process-loss. Ticker not named. Do not invent one.
trades.source: Schwager / elearnmarkets summary of Unknown Market Wizards.
trades.thesis_zh: Schwager 记述他听了别人的意见、亏损砍掉三分之二的看涨期权，论点后来被验证。
trades.outcome_zh: 流程上的亏损。代码未点名。不要编一个代码。

trades.name: Mattel / Barbie
trades.thesis: Named as a favorite example by Chart Academy / Matt Ober.
trades.outcome: No primary Camillo P&L in our sources. Third-party mention only.
trades.thesis_zh: Chart Academy / Matt Ober 称为喜欢的例子。
trades.outcome_zh: 我们的来源里没有 Camillo 的一手盈亏。只是第三方提及。

trades.name: Abercrombie
trades.thesis: Third-party favorite example.
trades.outcome: No primary P&L.
trades.thesis_zh: 第三方喜欢的例子。
trades.outcome_zh: 没有一手盈亏。

trades.name: Coors / seltzer
